params.prompt: High-end modern website design for ATLAS GROUP, a Michigan real estate, insurance, mortgage and construction company. Crisp flat UI screenshot, no device mockup. Palette true white #FFFFFF, ink navy #14263D, vivid blue #3268F5. Modern light-medium weight grotesk typography like Manrope. Airy asymmetrical editorial design, square-corner media, 64px outer gutters, fine horizontal rules. Simple outlined arrow icons. No gradients except neutral black readability fade over hero photo. No fake metrics, awards, testimonials, invented team members or fake listings. All text is readable and implementable in HTML/CSS. Desktop first viewport 1440x810. White 88px header with small blue A emblem and navy uppercase ATLAS GROUP wordmark left; navigation Services, Our approach, About Atlas; blue button Let’s talk at right. Below header full-width cinematic dusk photograph of a beautiful contemporary Michigan brick-and-wood home amid trees, warm windows, cobalt twilight, house mostly on right. Hero lower-left white large 84px headline exactly "Your next chapter. Built together." across three lines; below body "Real estate, insurance, mortgages, and construction. Connected around you." Main blue button "Find your next step" with diagonal arrow. Bottom-right tiny text "Rooted in Michigan. Looking forward." Minimal round pause button at far bottom-right. Hero has neutral black left-side readability gradient. Bottom of viewport shows a white four-column open service navigation strip with Real estate / Insurance / Mortgages / Construction and small arrows. No hero eyebrow or pretitle.
